We collect your name, email, phone number, and pickup location to coordinate food reservations. Order history is used to calculate your personal impact stats.
Your data helps match you with nearby surplus food, verify pickups with business partners, and calculate the money you\'ve saved and food you\'ve rescued.
Business partners can see your name and order details only to confirm pickup. We don\'t sell your personal data to third parties.
Use a strong, unique password for your account. You can sign out at any time from the top of your Profile page.
How do I reserve a surprise bag?
Browse nearby deals on the Home tab, tap a listing, choose your quantity, and confirm your reservation. You\'ll get a pickup ticket with a collection PIN.
What if I can\'t make my pickup window?
Try to cancel as early as possible so the business can offer the food to someone else. Repeated no-shows may affect your account standing.
Go to Profile → Register as NGO, fill in your organization\'s details and registration number, and submit. Once approved, you can claim eligible food for free.
Payments are processed through BiteSaver Pay using your in-app e-wallet balance. We don\'t store your card details on your device.
Turning unsold food into saved value.
BiteSaver connects food businesses with surplus, unsold-but-safe food to nearby consumers at a discount, and to registered NGOs for free — reducing food waste while making meals more affordable.
This app supports UN Sustainable Development Goal 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) and Goal 2 (Zero Hunger).
